faqs.a:
The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this article, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning:
Health and athletic club
means any establishment that is primarily engaged in the operation of a fitness or
               other health club, spa, or similar facility featuring exercise and other active physical
               fitness conditioning, whether or not on a membership basis. The term "health and athletic
               club" does not include any golf course, membership sports or recreation club, or other
               establishment primarily engaged in the operation of sports, amusement, or recreation
               services.
Place or event open to the public
means any place or event to which admission or access is open to members of the public
               upon the payment of a charge or fee. This term includes without limitation the following
               places or events when a charge or fee for admission to such places or events is imposed
               upon members of the public any:
(1)
Performance of a motion picture, stage show, play, concert or other manifestation
                  of the performing arts;
(2)
Sporting or athletic contest, exhibit, or event, either amateur or professional;
(3)
Lecture, rally, speech, or dissertation;
(4)
Showing, display, or exhibition of any type, including art exhibitions; and
(5)
Restaurant, tavern, lounge, or club, whether the admission is called a "cover charge,"
                  "door charge," or any other such term.
(Code 1981, § 31-131; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002;
Ord. No. 4548, § 2, 5-2-2016
)
